appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Sofi looks. System matches your OS preference automatically.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose your preferred language. Sofi will restart the UI in the selected language.

apiTokens.title: API Tokens
apiTokens.description: Long-lived bearer tokens for CLI or automation clients. The plaintext value is shown only once.
apiTokens.revealTitle: Copy your token now — it won't be shown again.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Wipes your user, boards, tasks, attachments, and API tokens.
dangerZone.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete your account and every board, task, attachment, and API token owned by you. There is no recovery.
